purpose: Country evidence inventory for later crop-specific enterprise budgets. Not a calculator input file and not authority to activate the country.

evidence_sections.topic: sector structure, land constraints and priority products
evidence_sections.source_name: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy; Republic of Seychelles Voluntary National Review 2025; Seychelles Trade Portal
evidence_sections.reference_date: VNR first published June 2025; ministry and trade portal accessed 2026-11-01

observations.finding: The 2025 Voluntary National Review reports about 400 hectares dedicated to cultivation.
VNR reports agriculture contributes approximately 1.6% of GDP; the trade portal separately states about 2.5%, so definitions/reference periods require reconciliation.
Government sources identify sweet potato, cassava, breadfruit, banana, cinnamon and tea; the trade portal also lists poultry and tuna.
Poultry and pork are identified as domestic livestock value chains.
The ministry identifies limited arable land, high production costs, reliance on imported inputs, climate vulnerability and exposure to external shocks.

caveats: The 400-hectare figure is a national overview, not a crop-specific harvested-area denominator.
GDP-share figures differ between government sources (1.6% in VNR versus about 2.5% on the trade portal); do not combine without checking definitions and reference years.
Priority lists do not establish crop suitability, yield or profitability by island.

evidence_sections.topic: farm structure and official statistical capacity
evidence_sections.source_name: Central Bank of Seychelles Annual Report 2024 reporting on the Agriculture Department census; National Bureau of Statistics Seychelles
evidence_sections.reference_date: Central Bank annual report submitted 31 March 2025; NBS portal accessed 2026-11-01

observations.finding: The Agriculture Department conducted a census covering 725 registered farmers on Mahé, Praslin, La Digue and the Inner Islands, supported by the SANOI regional project and NBS.
The census aimed to update farm-holding structure, characteristics and types of farming activity for planning and monitoring.
NBS compiles monthly consumer price indices. CPI measures consumer price movements, not actual price levels or farmgate prices.

caveats: The annual report confirms census coverage and purpose but does not provide the detailed crop-by-crop census tables in the cited passage.
A census of 725 registered farmers may not represent every household or informal producer; check the census frame and final report before using it as national coverage.
CPI is not a substitute for farmgate producer prices.

evidence_sections.topic: pig, pork import and poultry sector indicators
evidence_sections.source_name: Seychelles Nation interview/report on livestock production challenges, citing sector production and import statistics

observations.finding: The report describes high animal-feed costs, removal of feed subsidy and at least six farms ceasing operations over the preceding two years; remaining farms were reported as operating below capacity.
Pig farmers were reported to rely heavily on butchers, limiting margins and market access.

caveats: The news report is a secondary publication and should be cross-checked against Agriculture Department and customs tables.
Pig output and pork imports are different measures and must not be conflated; import volume is not a domestic producer price.
No farm-level feed conversion, mortality, carcass yield or complete production cost schedule is provided.

evidence_sections.topic: egg supply, producer selling prices and retail prices
evidence_sections.source_name: Seychelles Nation report on 2025 agricultural milestones
caveats: These are dated press-reported prices, not a current 2026 quotation or a verified official monthly time series.
Producer prices and retail prices are deliberately separated; only the producer ranges are potential farmgate/first-sale leads, subject to confirmation of transaction point and grading.
Tray pack size is not specified in the report; do not convert tray prices to per-egg values without confirmation.

evidence_sections.source_name: Seychelles Nation, Egg prices slide as supply rebounds

observations.finding: The article reports local eggs had fallen to as low as SCR 105 per tray after reaching as high as SCR 7 per egg in December.

caveats: This is a market report, not a national average or verified farmgate series; the tray count and farm/retail point are not specified in the summary.
The price movement demonstrates volatility and should not be used as a fixed calculator price.

evidence_sections.source_name: World Bank World Development Indicators series as displayed by IndexBox
evidence_sections.reference_date: WDI data through 2024; display updated 14 October 2026
caveats: This is an aggregate index, not tonnes, yield, harvested area or a crop-specific observation.
The source is a secondary display of World Bank WDI series AG.PRD.CROP.XD_SC; verify directly in WDI before operational use.

evidence_sections.topic: producer price and consumer price source availability
evidence_sections.source_name: FAOSTAT Agricultural Producer Prices metadata; National Bureau of Statistics Seychelles CPI and PPI descriptions
evidence_sections.reference_date: FAOSTAT dataset revision 4 December 2025; NBS pages accessed 2026-11-01

observations.finding: FAOSTAT producer prices represent prices received by farmers at the farmgate or first point of sale, with annual series from 1991 and monthly series from January 2010 for covered countries and products.
CPI tracks changes in consumer prices, not actual price levels.
NBS manufacturing PPI is limited to manufacturing, electricity and water supply; it is not a farm producer-price index.

caveats: A metadata description does not prove that every Seychelles crop has a non-missing, current FAOSTAT producer price observation.
The NBS PPI page explicitly does not describe an agricultural producer price series.
Extract the actual country/product/year records and flags before treating any value as a usable farmgate price.

evidence_sections.source_name: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy and Seychelles Nation sector coverage

observations.finding: Agriculture policy and administration sit within a ministry whose mandate also includes fisheries and the blue economy.
Recent national coverage references seaweed and aquaculture development; separate fisheries/aquaculture enterprise models would need species-specific biological and licensing data.

caveats: Marine capture fisheries, aquaculture and crop/livestock enterprises require separate production models and should not be combined into a crop-profit calculator profile without distinct data structures.
No species-level production costs, farmgate prices, stocking rates or harvest-cycle evidence has been established in this review.

evidence_sections.topic: latest official statistical releases, livestock production trend, current support measures and data availability
evidence_sections.source_name: Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy; National Bureau of Statistics; Central Bank of Seychelles; Seychelles News Agency
evidence_sections.reference_date: Official ministry update 4 November 2026; NBS publication programme and time-series archive checked 4 November 2026; CBS 2025 annual report; livestock support announcement 5 August 2026

observations.finding: FAO-supported two-week compilation workshop began 19 October 2026 and the Ministry reported on 4 November 2026 that national experts are strengthening compilation and validation of Seychelles Food Balance Sheets for 2023, 2024 and 2025, subject to data availability. This is a statistical-capacity milestone, not a released commodity production dataset or farm budget.

NBS Production Statistics page links latest indicators; the NBS Data Series downloads page lists a Production Statistics time-series Excel file created 31 August 2026. The 2026 publication programme marks Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 production-statistics releases as released. The relevant workbook still requires extraction and identification of agricultural variables, units and coverage.

Central Bank of Seychelles Annual Report 2025 estimates agricultural-sector output declined 10% in 2025. Over January–September, egg production declined 18%, while slaughtered cattle rose 41%, broiler chickens rose 10%, culled pigs fell 0.3%, and animal-feed volume fell 3.8%. These are year-on-year sector indicators, not farm yields, prices or per-unit costs.

observations.period: announced 5 August 2026; review every six months
observations.finding: Government announced an initial SCR20 million livestock support package, including reimbursement of up to 30% of eligible animal-feed costs for registered livestock farmers. Poultry slaughter support is SCR5 toward a SCR7 fee per bird; pig slaughter support is SCR400 toward a SCR500 fee. The ministry reported 158 registered livestock farmers and only 7 active broiler farms among 27 registered broiler farmers. Feed represents about 60–67% of livestock production costs. These are policy terms and sector context, not observed feed prices or a full enterprise budget.

The August 2026 report quotes the minister that local production supplies about 10% of poultry and 12% of pork consumed domestically. Treat these as reported supply shares, not yield or profitability indicators.

caveats: The November 2026 Food Balance Sheet work is still a compilation/validation exercise; do not treat it as a released national table.
NBS Production Statistics workbook is identified but crop/livestock series have not yet been extracted from the workbook; do not invent values.
Annual sector output changes and slaughter/egg changes are not farm-level production quantities or per-hectare yields.
Feed subsidy eligibility and slaughter-fee support reduce eligible farmer expenses but do not establish the unsubsidised feed price, farmer's actual net cost, or complete cost per bird/pig.
Current farmgate prices, crop input quotations, labour rates and island-level enterprise budgets remain unavailable in the reviewed sources.

calculator_data_gaps: Extract the detailed 2024 Agriculture Census tables: farm counts, land area, crop areas, crop output, livestock inventories and island/district breakdowns.
Download and extract the NBS Production Statistics time-series workbook (latest listed 31 August 2026) and identify agriculture-related series, definitions, units, reference periods and revisions.

Obtain the detailed 2023–2025 national Food Balance Sheet tables after the FAO-supported compilation and validation work is published; distinguish production, imports, exports, stocks, losses and food use.
Verify the current cultivated-land estimate and reconcile the agriculture GDP-share estimates reported as 1.6% in the 2025 VNR versus about 2.5% on the trade portal.
Download and validate original FAOSTAT crop production, harvested-area, yield and producer-price series for Seychelles, including item codes, years, units and observation flags.
Collect current farmgate/first-sale prices by crop, grade, island, unit and season; distinguish producer prices from retail, wholesale and import prices.
Obtain actual feed supplier quotations and confirm the 2026 subsidy eligibility, claim process, payment timing and farmer net-of-subsidy feed cost.
Obtain current feed formulations, veterinary costs, chicks/piglet costs, mortality, carcass yield, labour, energy and housing costs for poultry and pig enterprise budgets.
Obtain seed/planting material, fertiliser, crop-protection, irrigation, labour, transport and packaging quotations for sweet potato, cassava, banana, breadfruit, cinnamon, tea and vegetables.
Confirm egg tray pack size, sales channel and current 2026 producer versus retail prices before converting any press-reported values to calculator inputs.
Develop island-specific budgets reflecting land scarcity, imported input exposure, freight and water/irrigation costs.
For aquaculture/fisheries, gather separate species-specific production, licensing, feed, equipment, harvest and first-sale price evidence.

activation_blockers: Detailed 2024 agricultural census crop tables and island-level production data not yet extracted
NBS Production Statistics workbook located but agricultural series not yet extracted and validated
2023–2025 Food Balance Sheets are under compilation/validation and are not yet established as published observations
No validated current crop-specific farmgate price series
Only limited dated producer-price leads for eggs; current price and transaction details require confirmation
Livestock feed and slaughter subsidies announced in August 2026, but actual supplier prices and farmer net costs remain unverified
No complete crop or livestock enterprise budgets and current input quotations
Conflicting official/portal agriculture GDP-share estimates need reconciliation

safeguards: Research-only evidence; not a live calculator dataset.
Do not activate Seychelles or change calculator formulas based on this file.
Do not substitute retail egg prices, consumer CPI, manufacturing PPI, import values or aggregate production indices for crop-specific farmgate prices.
Keep crop, livestock and fisheries/aquaculture enterprise models distinct.
